format_selection.rule: As ../look-agreement/SELECTION.json, with the LLM's draft-v2-device as the baseline: a candidate hint is eligible if, on the selection half, at least as many of its drafts pass the source checks as with draft-v2-device and its shown briefs hold no more unsupported sentences. Among eligible hints choose the most passing drafts, then the most format checks met by the raw replies (title three to eight words, summary at most 70 words, asks about another camera view, asks about the site procedure, cites every evidence ID), then the lower median generation time. If none is eligible, or none beats draft-v2-device on that order, draft-v2-device stays. A chosen hint is run once on the 10 held-out candidates and the decision uses it; draft-v2-device's held-out result is reported either way.

decision.rule: Adopt the LLM HEF for the device draft phase only if all four hold, with the hint chosen above: (1) on the held-out half at least 8 of 10 drafts pass the source checks (the VLM-text result); (2) its shown held-out briefs hold at most 2 unsupported sentences (the CPU path's count on the same half; the VLM-text drafts had 0, with 2 of their 10 briefs being templates); (3) the median seconds per draft over its 20 drafts is below 41.891 s (VLM-text after the early-stop fix, all 20); (4) the swap pays for itself in a draft phase the size of the demo night's: the median round-trip swap cost (VLM release + LLM load + LLM release + VLM load) is below 9 x (41.891 s - the LLM's median seconds per draft). Otherwise the device keeps drafting with the VLM in text-only mode, and the result is documented only.
